original_question: Rani has ten more crabs than Monic, who has 4 fewer crabs than Bo. If Bo has 40 crabs, calculate the total number of crabs the three have together.
question_template: {name_female_1, Rani} has {num_text_1, ten} more crabs than {name_female_2, Monic}, who has {num_digit_1, 4} fewer crabs than {name_male_1, Bo}. If {name_male_1, Bo} has {num_digit_2, 40} crabs, calculate the total number of crabs the three have together.
question_solution: answer = num_digit_2 + (num_digit_2 - num_digit_1) + ((num_digit_2 - num_digit_1) + t1)   # t1 is the numeric value of num_text_1
